Sync Java EMAPI SDK with Dart EMAPI semantics

Sync Java EMAPI SDK with Dart EMAPI semantics

Details:
- Implement the Java EMAPI public facade, command payload helpers, session behavior, report models, WiFi/RFID/printer/file/OTA operations, and MTU-aware chunking aligned with the Dart implementation.
- Extend frame, TLV, endian, and chunking support to cover protocol validation, ACK-gated transfer, active reports, passthrough/error handling, pending frame retention, timeout, and retry behavior.
- Update Java parent Maven metadata to use Java 8 compiler defaults and current Lombok annotation processing so the reactor builds on the current JDK.
